goal: A project can add and remove member roles, reviewers, approvers, and watchers, and apply role, repository, CI, and environment WIP policies that block overloaded assignment
scenarios: a project adds a role to a team member and records the change
a project removes a role from a team member
a WorkItem gets a reviewer, approver, or watcher from the project roster
a reviewer, approver, or watcher can be removed
role, repository, CI, and environment WIP policies block a new assignment when the limit is reached
humans and agents can have different WIP policies
the team capacity view shows overload warnings from those policies
customers cannot change the roster, roles, participants, or WIP policies
constraints: members remain humans, agents, service accounts, or external reviewers
the same person can hold different roles in different projects
member-level concurrent WorkItem limits remain in force
